how.gist: Bracing your body still, draw the biggest slow circle you can with one straight arm, forward, overhead, behind and down.
steps: Stand tall, make a fist with one hand and brace your trunk so nothing else moves.
Raise the straight arm forward and up overhead, as close to your ear as you can.
Turn the palm out and keep circling back and down behind you to your side.
That full slow circle is one rep; reverse the direction, then switch arms.
how.watch: Leaning or twisting the body to make the circle bigger.
how.easier: Make the circles smaller, or do them lying on your back.
how.harder: Move slower and squeeze the fist harder through the whole circle.

how.gist: Hanging from rings or a bar, roll back through your arms and lower your legs behind you to stretch the front of the shoulders.
steps: Hang from rings or a bar, then tuck your knees and roll back through your arms.
Keep going until your feet lower behind you and your shoulders open.
Hold the bottom with straight arms, breathing; go only as deep as you can control.
Tuck and roll back the way you came to come out.
how.watch: Dropping into the bottom fast, with no control of how deep the shoulders go.
how.easier: Use low rings so your feet can stay on the floor for support.
how.harder: Do Skin the cat, passing through and back with control.

how.gist: Holding a post at waist height, sit your hips back and away to the side to stretch along the side of your back.
steps: Hold a post, rack or door frame at about waist height with one hand.
Step back and sit your hips back and away to the side, arm straight.
Let your chest sink until the side of your back stretches.
Hold and breathe, then switch sides.
how.watch: Shrugging the shoulder up instead of letting the side of the body lengthen.
how.easier: Do Puppy pose instead.
how.harder: Hang from a bar and let your body relax down, as in Dead hang.

how.gist: From all fours, walk your hands forward with your hips high over your knees and let your chest sink toward the floor.
steps: Start on all fours with your hips over your knees.
Walk your hands forward, keeping your hips high above your knees.
Let your chest sink toward the floor, arms long, forehead resting down.
Hold and breathe. On a bench: elbows on the edge, bend them, hands behind your head.
how.watch: Hips sliding back toward the heels, which turns it into Child's pose.
how.easier: Rest your forehead on a cushion and keep the hands closer.

how.gist: Raise one arm, bend the elbow so the hand drops behind your head, and ease the elbow back with the other hand.
steps: Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow so your hand drops behind your head.
Hold the raised elbow with the other hand.
Gently ease the elbow back and in until the back of the arm stretches.
Stand tall with ribs down; hold, breathe, then switch arms.
how.watch: Arching the low back to get the arm further back.

how.gist: Sitting tall, tilt your ear toward one shoulder while the other shoulder stays down to stretch the side of the neck.
steps: Sit or stand tall and let one arm hang, or hold the side of your seat with that hand.
Tilt your head the other way, ear toward shoulder, nose facing forward.
Rest the other hand on your head for a little extra stretch, without pulling.
Hold and breathe, then switch sides.
how.watch: Hunching the shoulder up on the side being stretched.

video.title: Upper Trapezius Stretch

how.gist: Standing on one leg, hold the other ankle behind you and draw the heel toward your glute to stretch the front of the thigh.
steps: Stand on one leg, holding a wall for balance if needed.
Bend the other knee and hold that ankle or foot behind you.
Draw the heel toward your glute, knees together, pelvis tucked under a little.
Hold and breathe, then switch legs.
how.watch: Arching the low back and letting the knee drift forward or out.
how.easier: Loop a strap or towel round the foot if you cannot reach it.
how.harder: Do Couch stretch instead.

how.gist: Hands on a wall, one foot back with the heel down, lean in to stretch the calf; bend the back knee to reach lower.
steps: Face a wall with your hands on it and step one foot back.
Keep the back leg straight, heel down and toes pointing forward.
Bend the front knee and lean toward the wall until the back calf stretches.
Hold, then bend the back knee slightly to move the stretch lower; switch sides.
how.watch: Back heel lifting or the back foot turning out.
how.harder: Stand with the ball of the foot on a step and let the heel drop.

video.title: Stretch Your Calves Against The Wall (CORRECTLY)

how.gist: With your foot a few inches from a wall, drive your knee forward to touch it without lifting the heel, then back off.
steps: Stand or half-kneel facing a wall, front toes a few inches from it.
Keep the heel down and drive the knee forward over your middle toes to touch the wall.
Back off until the leg is straight again; that is one rep.
Move the foot further back as it gets easier; finish the set and switch sides.
how.watch: Heel lifting or the knee caving inward to reach the wall.
how.harder: Loop a band round the front of the ankle, anchored low behind you.

video.title: Knee To Wall Exercise for Ankle Mobility

how.gist: Holding your shin still, draw the biggest slow circle you can with your foot, moving only at the ankle, then reverse.
steps: Sit with one leg crossed or lifted, and hold the shin still with your hand.
Point the foot, then slowly draw the biggest circle you can with your toes.
Move only at the ankle, in, up, out and down; one full circle is one rep.
Reverse the direction, then switch feet.
how.watch: Turning the knee or shin to make the circle, so the ankle is not doing it.
how.harder: Do them standing on the other leg, without holding the shin.

video.title: Ankle CAR (Controlled Articular Rotation)

how.gist: Kneel with the tops of your feet flat and sit back on your heels to stretch the shins and fronts of the ankles.
steps: Kneel with the tops of your feet flat on the floor, toes pointing straight back.
Sit back onto your heels, hands on the floor beside you.
For more, lean back on your hands and lift your knees a little off the floor.
Hold and breathe; ease off if your ankles or knees pinch.
how.watch: Feet rolling out to the sides so the stretch slides off the shins.
how.easier: Put a folded towel under your ankles, or keep weight in your hands.

video.title: Kneeling Shin Stretch - 321 STRONG

how.gist: Kneel with your toes tucked under and sit back onto your heels to stretch the toes and soles of the feet.
steps: Kneel with your toes tucked under and your heels pointing up.
Sit back slowly onto your heels, hands on your thighs or the floor.
Keep your heels together so every toe, the big toe included, takes the stretch.
Hold and breathe, then lean forward onto your hands to come out.
how.watch: Heels splaying apart so the big toes escape the stretch.
how.easier: Keep your hands on the floor in front to take some weight off.

video.title: Kneeling Toe Stretches

how.gist: With one arm straight and palm up, gently pull the fingers back toward the floor to stretch the inside of the forearm.
steps: Hold one arm straight out in front, palm up.
With the other hand, gently pull the fingers back and down toward the floor.
Keep the elbow straight until the inside of the forearm stretches.
Hold and breathe, then switch arms.
how.watch: Bending the elbow, which takes the stretch off the forearm.
how.harder: Kneel with palms on the floor, fingers toward your knees, and lean back.

how.gist: With one arm straight and palm down, let the hand drop and press it gently toward you to stretch the back of the forearm.
steps: Hold one arm straight out in front, palm down.
Let the hand drop, then press the back of it gently toward you with the other hand.
Curl the fingers into a loose fist for more stretch, elbow straight.
Hold and breathe, then switch arms.
how.watch: Bending the elbow or shrugging the shoulder as you press.
how.harder: Kneel with the backs of your hands on the floor, fingers toward your knees.

video.title: Wrist Extensor Stretch

how.gist: On all fours with palms flat, rock your shoulders forward past your hands and back, then repeat with the fingers turned.
steps: Start on all fours, hands flat under your shoulders, fingers forward.
Rock your shoulders forward past your hands, then back over your knees.
Forward and back is one rep; keep the palms flat and stay in a comfortable range.
Repeat with the fingers turned out, then turned back toward your knees.
how.watch: Heels of the hands lifting off the floor as you rock forward.
how.easier: Keep more weight back in your knees and rock a shorter way.
